专业色觉缺陷（CVD）模拟器。支持红色盲、红色弱、绿色盲、绿色弱、蓝色盲、蓝色弱: A professional color vision deficiency (CVD) simulator. It models 8 vision types in real time — protanopia, protanomaly, deuteranopia, deuteranomaly, tritanopia, tritanomaly, achromatopsia and blue-cone monochromacy — and transforms a single color, an entire palette or an uploaded image. Includes a WCAG 2.1 contrast checker, a CIE Delta-E confusion matrix and color-blind-safe palette suggestions. Everything runs locally in your browser; images are never uploaded.
红色盲/绿色盲/蓝色盲采用 Machado、Oliveira 与 Fernand: Protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia use the linear RGB transform matrices of Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes (2009). Each matrix folds the three steps "sRGB -> LMS cone response -> deficient-cone compensation -> inverse transform" into a single 3x3 matrix applied to linear-light RGB. Anomalous trichromacy is obtained by linearly interpolating between the identity matrix and the full dichromat matrix according to severity. Achromatopsia is a straight Rec.709 luminance greyscale. Blue-cone monochromacy is an approximation: luminance follows the scotopic luminosity function V'(lambda) — rods barely respond at the red end and peak in the green, so patients see red as darkest and green as relatively bright — while hue keeps only the S-cone "blue excess" over a grey of equal luminance, which is why white turns blue-tinted, yellow goes grey and red goes dark grey. Color difference is computed via sRGB -> CIE XYZ (D65) -> CIE Lab, reported as both Delta-E76 and Delta-E2000.
严重度仅在色弱型（anomaly）上按默认 60% 起算；完全型（opia）默认: Severity only applies to the anomalous types, starting at 60% by default; the complete types default to 100%. Drag the slider to watch the continuous shift from mild anomalous trichromacy to full dichromacy.

在 OKLCH 感知均匀空间采样候选色，逐一做 8 型色觉变换后转 CIE La: Candidate colors are sampled in the perceptually uniform OKLCH space, transformed for all 8 vision types and converted to CIE Lab; a greedy search then picks the set that maximizes the smallest pairwise ΔE across all 8 types.
本工具是设计与自查辅助工具，所有模拟结果来自色彩科学模型的数学推算，: This tool is a design and self-check aid. Every simulation is a mathematical projection from color-science models;
不等同于医学诊断: it is not equivalent to a medical diagnosis
，也不能替代色觉检查（如石原色盲检测图、Farnsworth D-15 排列测试: nor a substitute for clinical color-vision tests such as the Ishihara plates or the Farnsworth D-15 arrangement test. To find out whether you have a color vision deficiency, see a medical professional. Known limits of the model: blue-cone monochromacy is an approximation; severity interpolation is linear and deviates from real anomalous spectral response; display gamut and brightness also affect what you actually see.
